items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: we met him at the boat and we played a lot of things for him

ctx.x: On trombone. So we always said, we want to go to Europe. Bishop was

having trouble with his wife. She was putting him down. So we all saved up enough money and caught the Isle de France and went over there. But before we went Paradisio has been to New York, he came to New York somewhere down in that time.

And he told us he said if you ever get to France just let me know and I'll arrange something for you. And we always kept that in our minds you know, because we met him at the boat and we played a lot of things for him and Mezzrow was here then, Sidney Bechet Happy Caldwell, Jack Butler, a lot of them.
